title: sharpen-comprehend — the Comprehension lens (issue-sharpening 02)
description: One fresh reviewer's reading of a proposed issue body as a context-free implementer would read it, beside how the code works today. `audit_gate` checks the Input receipt and judges the round. _io is stamped by the server and is not part of this schema.

proposed_paraphrase.description: What the proposed issue now asks for, in your own words, as an implementer who has seen nothing else would read it.

existing_system_paraphrase.description: How the code at main works today in the area the issue touches, from the checkout.

findings.description: What is wrong with the proposal. [] when nothing is.

severity.description: blocker: the proposal must not be applied as it is. major: a real problem that must be fixed first. nit: worth saying, never blocks.

criterion_ref.description: `AC<n>` of the original criterion the finding is about, or null when it is about the whole proposal.

evidence.description: Where the finding comes from: path:line in the checkout, `proposed.md`, `changes.md`, `original_criteria.md` or `ci.md`.

says.description: What is there, quoted or in one sentence.
